creator: laredson
releaseBasis: v1.1 Clean RC1 is rebuilt from the user-proven v1.1 working baseline. It keeps the original-mods-plus-minimal-compatibility-patch model, priority-aware conflict resolution, exact runtime-proven Knowledge recipes, AI_HANDOFF/manual tested contribution export, saved-patch reuse based on effective conflict winners, a bundled offline .NET 8.0.30 runtime, and background Analyze/Build/Game Reference workers. Developer Console, Mod Edit and the retired MegaMerge path are excluded.
dependencyPolicy: Public v1.1 bundles and verifies repak, mappings, prebuilt PMMCore, AssetReader, and the pinned portable .NET Runtime 8.0.30. Healthy startup performs local verification only. Network repair is attempted only when a required redistributable is missing or invalid, with bounded download timeouts.
releasePackagingPolicy: Clean public/RC package. No user/source PAK imports, generated compatibility patches, saves, runtime Data state, logs, local Game Reference cache, Oodle DLL, PDBs, or release-builder artifacts are shipped. Runtime-created directories start empty.
uiContract: Window title identifies CLEAN RC1 during validation. Public workflow tabs are Mods & Merge, Saves and Settings. No Developer Console or Mod Edit workspace is present.
mergeOutputModel: Preserve original mods and generate only the PMM compatibility patch needed for conflicting content.
savedPatchReusePolicy: Exact active source hashes/mappings remain required for physical patch reuse; full-list reordering is ignored when it does not change a priority-derived conflict winner. PatchContentSignature records the generated cooked output evidence.
